dish.title: Salade Niçoise with Seared Tuna
dish.description: A dinner-sized composed salad: pepper-crusted seared ahi tuna sliced rare, warm baby potatoes tossed in Dijon-shallot vinaigrette, jammy 7-minute eggs, crisp green beans, cherry tomatoes, olives, and capers on butter lettuce. Dairy-free vinaigrette; no butter anywhere.

recipe_version.title: Salade Niçoise with Seared Tuna
recipe_version.description: A dinner-sized composed salad: pepper-crusted seared ahi tuna sliced rare, warm baby potatoes tossed in Dijon-shallot vinaigrette, jammy 7-minute eggs, crisp green beans, cherry tomatoes, olives, and capers on butter lettuce. Dairy-free vinaigrette; no butter anywhere.

ingredients.name: yellowfin tuna steaks
ingredients.display_name: yellowfin (ahi) tuna steaks, about 1 inch thick
ingredients.note: 2 to 3 steaks from the supermarket seafood counter or freezer case (thaw overnight in the fridge if frozen). Previously frozen sushi/sashimi-grade is preferred because the center is served rare; sear 3 minutes per side instead if anyone wants it cooked through. Finfish.

ingredients.name: baby potatoes
ingredients.display_name: baby Yukon Gold or red potatoes

ingredients.name: eggs
ingredients.note: cold from the fridge. Egg allergen (HH001 allows eggs).

ingredients.name: pitted olives
ingredients.note: either olive is fine; both are brine-cured olives with no dairy

ingredients.name: butter lettuce
ingredients.note: 1 large head (or 2 heads Little Gem). 'Butter' is the lettuce variety; there is no butter (dairy) in this recipe.

ingredients.name: anchovy fillets
ingredients.note: OPTIONAL garnish. Finfish is already declared for the tuna, so this does not change eligibility or allergens.

ingredients.name: Dijon mustard
ingredients.note: Dijon is mustard seed, vinegar/wine, and salt; it contains no dairy. Mustard is not a FlavorWeave allergen token (see allergen_notes).

ingredients.name: neutral high-heat oil
ingredients.note: for searing the tuna. Not peanut oil.

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: divided: 1 tbsp (3 tsp) for the cooking water, 1/2 tsp for the vinaigrette, 3/4 tsp for the tuna

ingredients.name: black pepper
ingredients.note: divided: 1/2 tsp tuna crust, 1/4 tsp vinaigrette, 1/4 tsp to finish

steps.title: Start the water and prep
steps.body: Fill a 5- to 6-quart pot with 3 quarts water, add 1 tbsp of the kosher salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat (about 10 minutes; this overlaps the prep). Halve the potatoes, trim the green beans, halve the cherry tomatoes, separate, wash, and dry the lettuce leaves, mince the shallot, grate the garlic, chop the parsley, and drain the capers. Set out a large bowl of ice water. Pat the tuna dry and leave it on a plate while you work. About 12 minutes.

clock.note: pot comes to a boil during this prep block

steps.title: Shake the Dijon-shallot vinaigrette
steps.body: In a jar, combine the minced shallot, 3 tbsp red wine vinegar, and 1/2 tsp kosher salt; let it sit while you measure the rest so the shallot mellows. Add the 1 tbsp Dijon, the grated garlic, 1/4 tsp cracked pepper, and the 1/2 cup extra-virgin olive oil. Close and shake hard until creamy and emulsified. The dressing is oil, vinegar, and mustard only: no butter, cream, yogurt, or cheese. About 3 minutes.

steps.title: Boil the potatoes and jammy eggs in one pot
steps.body: Add the potatoes to the boiling water and keep it at a steady boil. After 6 minutes, gently lower the cold eggs into the same pot with a slotted spoon. Boil 7 more minutes, then move the eggs to the ice water. Test a potato: a knife should slide in with no resistance. Lift the potatoes out with the slotted spoon into a wide bowl and toss them while hot with 2 tbsp of the vinaigrette so they absorb it. Keep the water boiling. About 13 minutes.

steps.title: Blanch the green beans; heat the skillet
steps.body: Drop the green beans into the same boiling water and cook 2 1/2 to 3 minutes, until bright green and crisp-tender. Move them to the ice water with the eggs for 1 minute, then drain and pat dry. At the same time, set a 12-inch cast-iron or heavy stainless skillet over high heat with the 1 tbsp neutral oil so it is shimmering hot by the time the beans are out. About 3 minutes.

steps.title: Sear the tuna
steps.body: Season the tuna on all sides with 3/4 tsp kosher salt and 1/2 tsp cracked pepper, pressing the pepper in. Lay the steaks in the shimmering skillet and do not move them: 1 1/2 to 2 minutes per side for a rare, deep-red center with a thin cooked band (about 115 F inside), or 3 minutes per side to cook through (145 F). Briefly sear the edges with tongs. Move to a cutting board. About 4 minutes.

steps.title: Rest the tuna; peel the eggs
steps.body: Let the tuna rest 3 to 4 minutes. Meanwhile peel the eggs under a trickle of water and halve them lengthwise; the yolks should be jammy and just set at the edges. About 4 minutes.

steps.title: Slice and compose
steps.body: Slice the tuna across the grain into 1/2-inch slices. Line a large platter or 4 shallow plates with lettuce leaves. Arrange the dressed potatoes, green beans, cherry tomatoes, egg halves, and olives in separate groups, and fan the tuna slices in the center. Scatter the capers and parsley; drape the anchovy fillets over the eggs if using. Spoon the remaining vinaigrette over everything and finish with the last 1/4 tsp cracked pepper. Serve right away while the potatoes are warm. About 5 minutes. kitchen_tested is false.

components.name: warm vinaigrette potatoes, jammy eggs, and blanched green beans (one pot)

recipe_version.time_clock: Prep 15 = 12 knife prep (the salted water comes to a boil during this block) + 3 vinaigrette. Cook 29 = 13 potatoes with eggs added at minute 6 + 3 green beans (skillet heats at the same time) + 4 sear + 4 rest/peel + 5 slice and compose. No oven.
recipe_version.heat: Stovetop only. High heat for the boiling water and a steady boil for potatoes/eggs/beans; high heat, shimmering oil for the tuna sear. No oven.
recipe_version.doneness: Potatoes knife-tender; eggs jammy (7 minutes from cold); beans bright green and crisp-tender; tuna seared on the outside with a deep-red rare center (about 115 F) or 145 F if cooked through by preference. kitchen_tested is false.

dietary_eligibility.nut_policy_note: No peanuts, tree nuts, or cashews. Olives and capers are not nuts.
dietary_eligibility.hh001_reason: Finfish (tuna; optional anchovy) and eggs are allowed for HH001. Vinaigrette is oil, vinegar, Dijon, shallot, and garlic: dairy-free by recipe, not by brand choice. No butter anywhere (butter lettuce is a lettuce variety). No shellfish, no meat other than fish, no poultry, no nuts.

recipe_version.dietary_label_note: Unconditional dairy_free: no butter, cream, yogurt, cheese, or milk in any component; the dressing is a mustard vinaigrette. Not vegetarian or plant-based (tuna, egg, optional anchovy).
allergen_notes: Finfish covers the yellowfin tuna and the optional anchovy fillets.
Egg covers the four jammy eggs.
Dijon mustard contains mustard seed. Mustard is a regulated allergen in some regions but is not a FlavorWeave allergen token; recorded here and in runtime_enum_gaps.
No milk, wheat, soy, sesame, peanut, tree_nut, shellfish, meat, or poultry.
recipe_version.hh001_reason: Finfish (tuna; optional anchovy) and eggs are allowed for HH001. Vinaigrette is oil, vinegar, Dijon, shallot, and garlic: dairy-free by recipe, not by brand choice. No butter anywhere (butter lettuce is a lettuce variety). No shellfish, no meat other than fish, no poultry, no nuts.

Salt split 3 + 1/2 + 3/4 tsp; pepper split 1/2 + 1/4 + 1/4 tsp.
1/2 cup olive oil in the vinaigrette (2 tbsp onto the hot potatoes, the rest over the salad) + 1 tbsp neutral oil to sear. No butter.

scaling_notes.1: One 5-oz tuna steak, 5 oz potatoes, 2 oz green beans, 1 egg, 1/4 of the tomatoes/olives, 1 tbsp capers is fine as 1 tsp. Make the full vinaigrette and refrigerate the leftover (keeps 5 days). Small saucepan; same timings.
scaling_notes.2: Halve the solids; make the full vinaigrette or halve it (a 1/2 tbsp Dijon is fine). Same timings; a 10-inch skillet works.
do_not_scale: tuna sear time per side (depends on thickness, not count)
toss potatoes with dressing while hot

coverage_contribution: French 0→1, dinner salad 0→1, tuna 0→1. Warm potatoes and jammy eggs make it a real October dinner, and it gives HH001 a fish dinner that is neither a fillet plate nor a taco.
near_duplicate_review: Compared with Grilled Swordfish with Olive-Caper Relish: shares olives/capers and finfish, but that is a grilled fillet plate with a relish; this is a composed salad with seared rare tuna, potatoes, eggs, beans, and a Dijon vinaigrette. Compared with Citrus Fennel Arctic Char, Miso-Ginger Salmon, Maple-Mustard Glazed Salmon: cooked-through fillet plates vs a rare-seared salad. Compared with Skillet Shakshuka: eggs are one component here, not the dish. Not a live-catalog duplicate.
